Name: Bigvai
Role: Leader of the Return; Head of a Father's House
Summary: A leader who returned with Zerubbabel, head of a large family, whose sons also returned with Ezra.
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:2; Ezra 2:14; Ezra 8:14; Nehemiah 7:7; Nehemiah 7:19; Nehemiah 10:16
LifeLesson: Faithfulness in returning to rebuild is remembered by name.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
